AIG-001Partial

Inventory of scorecards, ML, vendor, spreadsheet, and GenAI models

Core · AI & Model Governance · Owner: Model Risk Management

Acceptance boundary

Inventory of scorecards, ML, vendor, spreadsheet, and GenAI models is accepted when tenant-scoped execution fails closed on invalid authority or evidence, retains auditable lineage, and the cited automated control-family tests pass.

Current maturity and gap

Remaining gap for AIG-001: production-grade institutional configuration, external-provider or assessor evidence where applicable, and witnessed operating-effectiveness validation are not yet complete.
